label: One when the parent's 3R target is hit before its protective stop, zero for a stop. Open, censored, and unavailable fills never receive a binary label.
decision: Chosen 1h, 4h or 12h confirmation close, before the next hourly open. One score per confirmed event. Keep the parent's 1% outward wick buffer and fee-bearing frozen VectorBT outcomes.
fit: One shared L2 logistic regression, C=1, including timeframe indicators, no class reweighting or parameter search. Training-only median imputation and standardization. Use outcomes known by the training boundary, counting from the end of each exit-resolution bar.
selection: Fixed score quantiles from the fitted training cohort separately within each timeframe. Primary group is the 90th training percentile or higher in its own timeframe. Freeze all parameters before assessment.
test: 2025 and 2026 YTD separately and pooled. Never refit from these outcomes. Closed-trade hit rate and mean cost-adjusted R. Include censored counts, calibration, AUC and Brier versus training prevalence. All other target ladders are descriptive on the same scores.
primary_test: Pooled held-out top-decile mean net R must be positive and beat uniformly selecting the same count from the settled signals in each NY month, timeframe and side stratum with one-sided permutation p<0.01. Monthly cluster bootstrap for absolute high-group mean and excess; report years and timeframes even on failure.
